4	/// Declared substitute provider entry. Name resolution is data driven; provider

6	struct FactorySystemImageGlyphDescriptor: Sendable {
7	    let name: String
8	    let providerFamily: String

10	    let glyph: UInt32

16	    let rgba: [UInt8]
17	    let width: UInt32
18	    let height: UInt32
19	    let glyphWidth: UInt32
20	    let glyphHeight: UInt32

24	    let fontAscent: Int32
25	    let glyphOriginX: Int32

30	enum FactorySystemImageProviderError: Error {
31	    case invalidDescriptor
32	    case invalidTarget
33	    case deviceContextUnavailable
34	    case fontUnavailable
35	    case fontSelectionFailed
36	    case metricsUnavailable
37	    case glyphUnavailable
38	    case glyphBufferInvalid
39	    case emptyCoverage
40	}

42	/// Live GDI raster adapter for declared provider glyphs. ABI 0.6 only accepts
43	/// RGBA registration, so this returns target-sized coverage generated from current
44	/// provider font/glyph metrics; no cached sidecar bytes or Mac pixels are read.
45	enum FactorySystemImageProvider {
46	    private static func withWideCString<T>(_ value: String, _ body: (UnsafePointer<UInt16>) -> T) -> T {
47	        var units = Array(value.utf16) + [0]
48	        return units.withUnsafeBufferPointer { body($0.baseAddress!) }
49	    }
50	
51	    static func rasterize(_ descriptor: FactorySystemImageGlyphDescriptor,
52	                          width: UInt32, height: UInt32, tint: UInt32) throws -> FactorySystemImageRaster {
53	        guard !descriptor.name.isEmpty, descriptor.name.utf8.count <= 128,
54	              !descriptor.providerFamily.isEmpty, descriptor.providerFamily.utf8.count <= 128,
55	              !descriptor.providerVersion.isEmpty, descriptor.parity == "substitute-provider-unverified",
56	              descriptor.glyph <= 0x10ffff else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.invalidDescriptor }
57	        guard width > 0, height > 0, width <= 4096, height <= 4096,
58	              UInt64(width) * UInt64(height) <= (64 * 1024 * 1024) / 4 else {
59	            throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.invalidTarget
60	        }
61	
62	        guard let dc = CreateCompatibleDC(nil) else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.deviceContextUnavailable }
63	        defer { _ = DeleteDC(dc) }
64	        let fontHeight = Int32(max(width, height))
65	        let font: HFONT? = withWideCString(descriptor.providerFamily) { family in
66	            CreateFontW(-fontHeight, 0, 0, 0, Int32(FW_NORMAL), 0, 0, 0,
67	                        UINT32(DEFAULT_CHARSET), UINT32(OUT_DEFAULT_PRECIS),
68	                        UINT32(CLIP_DEFAULT_PRECIS), UINT32(CLEARTYPE_QUALITY),
69	                        UINT32(DEFAULT_PITCH | FF_DONTCARE), family)
70	        }
71	        guard let font else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.fontUnavailable }
72	        defer { _ = DeleteObject(font) }
73	        guard let previous = SelectObject(dc, font) else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.fontSelectionFailed }
74	        defer { _ = SelectObject(dc, previous) }
75	
76	        var faceBuffer = [UInt16](repeating: 0, count: 256)
77	        let faceLength = faceBuffer.withUnsafeMutableBufferPointer { buffer -> Int32 in
78	            GetTextFaceW(dc, Int32(buffer.count), buffer.baseAddress)
79	        }
80	        guard faceLength > 0, faceLength < Int32(faceBuffer.count) else {
81	            throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.fontSelectionFailed
82	        }
83	        let selectedFace = String(decoding: faceBuffer.prefix(Int(faceLength)), as: UTF16.self)
84	        guard !selectedFace.isEmpty else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.fontSelectionFailed }
85	
86	        var textMetrics = TEXTMETRICW()
87	        guard GetTextMetricsW(dc, &textMetrics) else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.metricsUnavailable }
88	        let fixedOne = FIXED(fract: 0, value: 1)
89	        let fixedZero = FIXED(fract: 0, value: 0)
90	        var transform = MAT2(eM11: fixedOne, eM12: fixedZero, eM21: fixedZero, eM22: fixedOne)
91	        var glyphMetrics = GLYPHMETRICS()
92	        let glyphCode = descriptor.glyph
93	        let required = GetGlyphOutlineW(dc, glyphCode, UINT32(GGO_GRAY8_BITMAP), &glyphMetrics,
94	                                        0, nil, &transform)
95	        guard required != UInt32(GDI_ERROR), required > 0 else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.glyphUnavailable }
96	        let glyphWidth = UInt32(glyphMetrics.gmBlackBoxX), glyphHeight = UInt32(glyphMetrics.gmBlackBoxY)
97	        guard glyphWidth > 0, glyphHeight > 0, glyphWidth <= width * 4, glyphHeight <= height * 4,
98	              required <= 16 * 1024 * 1024 else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.glyphBufferInvalid }
99	        var bitmap = Array(repeating: UInt8(0), count: Int(required))
100	        let rendered = bitmap.withUnsafeMutableBytes { raw in
101	            GetGlyphOutlineW(dc, glyphCode, UINT32(GGO_GRAY8_BITMAP), &glyphMetrics,
102	                             required, raw.baseAddress, &transform)
103	        }
104	        guard rendered == required else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.glyphBufferInvalid }
105	        let rowBytes = (Int(glyphWidth) + 3) & ~3
106	        guard rowBytes * Int(glyphHeight) <= bitmap.count else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.glyphBufferInvalid }
107	
108	        let targetWidth = Int(width), targetHeight = Int(height)
109	        var rgba = Array(repeating: UInt8(0), count: targetWidth * targetHeight * 4)
110	        let red = UInt8((tint >> 24) & 0xff), green = UInt8((tint >> 16) & 0xff)
111	        let blue = UInt8((tint >> 8) & 0xff), tintAlpha = UInt32(tint & 0xff)
112	        let originX = (targetWidth - Int(glyphWidth)) / 2
113	        let originY = (targetHeight - Int(glyphHeight)) / 2
114	        var nonZero: UInt32 = 0, maximum: UInt8 = 0
115	        // GDI glyph-outline buffers use bottom-up scanlines; ABI RGBA is top-down.
116	        for row in 0..<Int(glyphHeight) {
117	            let sourceRow = Int(glyphHeight) - 1 - row
118	            for column in 0..<Int(glyphWidth) {
119	                let targetX = originX + column, targetY = originY + row
120	                guard targetX >= 0, targetX < targetWidth, targetY >= 0, targetY < targetHeight else { continue }
121	                let gray = min(UInt32(bitmap[sourceRow * rowBytes + column]), 64)
122	                let coverage = UInt8((gray * 255 + 32) / 64)
123	                if coverage > 0 { nonZero += 1 }; maximum = max(maximum, coverage)
124	                let index = (targetY * targetWidth + targetX) * 4
125	                rgba[index] = red; rgba[index + 1] = green; rgba[index + 2] = blue
126	                rgba[index + 3] = UInt8((UInt32(coverage) * tintAlpha + 127) / 255)
127	            }
128	        }
129	        guard nonZero > 0 else { throw FactorySystemImageProviderError.emptyCoverage }
130	        return FactorySystemImageRaster(rgba: rgba, width: width, height: height,
131	            glyphWidth: glyphWidth, glyphHeight: glyphHeight, nonZeroCoverage: nonZero,
132	            maxCoverage: maximum, fontHeight: textMetrics.tmHeight,
133	            fontAscent: textMetrics.tmAscent, glyphOriginX: glyphMetrics.gmptGlyphOrigin.x,
134	            glyphOriginY: glyphMetrics.gmptGlyphOrigin.y, selectedFace: selectedFace)
135	    }

4	struct FactoryDefaultBodyFontPolicy {
5	    let family: String
6	    let fontSizeDIP: Float
7	    let lineHeightDIP: Float
8	    let weight: UInt32
9	    let logFontHeight: Int32
10	    let textMetricHeight: Int32
11	    let textMetricAscent: Int32
12	    let textMetricDescent: Int32
13	    let textMetricExternalLeading: Int32
14	    let sourceAPI: String
15	}
16	
17	enum FactoryDefaultBodyFontError: Error {
18	    case invalidScale
19	    case systemParametersUnavailable
20	    case invalidMessageFont
21	    case deviceContextUnavailable
22	    case fontUnavailable
23	    case fontSelectionUnavailable
24	    case selectedFaceUnavailable
25	    case textMetricsUnavailable
26	    case invalidMetrics
27	}
28	
29	/// Resolves Font.body from Windows' current message-font profile, then measures
30	/// that selected font through GDI. No Mac target size or family is substituted.
31	func factoryDefaultBodyFontPolicy(dpi: UInt32) throws -> FactoryDefaultBodyFontPolicy {
32	    guard dpi >= 48, dpi <= 768 else {
33	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.invalidScale
34	    }
35	    let scale = Float(dpi) / 96
36	
37	    var nonClient = NONCLIENTMETRICSW()
38	    nonClient.cbSize = UInt32(MemoryLayout<NONCLIENTMETRICSW>.size)
39	    let parametersOK = withUnsafeMutablePointer(to: &nonClient) { pointer in
40	        SystemParametersInfoForDpi(UInt32(0x0029), nonClient.cbSize,
41	                                   UnsafeMutableRawPointer(pointer), UInt32(0), dpi)
42	    }
43	    guard parametersOK else { throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.systemParametersUnavailable }
44	
45	    var logFont = nonClient.lfMessageFont
46	    let rawHeight = Int64(logFont.lfHeight)
47	    guard rawHeight != 0 else { throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.invalidMessageFont }
48	    let fontHeightPixels = abs(rawHeight)
49	
50	    guard let dc = CreateCompatibleDC(nil) else {
51	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.deviceContextUnavailable
52	    }
53	    defer { _ = DeleteDC(dc) }
54	
55	    guard let font = withUnsafePointer(to: &logFont, { CreateFontIndirectW($0) }) else {
56	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.fontUnavailable
57	    }
58	    defer { _ = DeleteObject(font) }
59	    guard let previous = SelectObject(dc, font) else {
60	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.fontSelectionUnavailable
61	    }
62	    defer { _ = SelectObject(dc, previous) }
63	
64	    var faceBuffer = [WCHAR](repeating: 0, count: 256)
65	    let faceLength = faceBuffer.withUnsafeMutableBufferPointer { buffer -> Int32 in
66	        GetTextFaceW(dc, Int32(buffer.count), buffer.baseAddress)
67	    }
68	    guard faceLength > 0, faceLength < Int32(faceBuffer.count) else {
69	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.selectedFaceUnavailable
70	    }
71	    let selectedFace = String(decoding: faceBuffer.prefix(Int(faceLength)).prefix(while: { $0 != 0 }), as: UTF16.self)
72	    guard !selectedFace.isEmpty else { throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.selectedFaceUnavailable }
73	
74	    var textMetrics = TEXTMETRICW()
75	    guard GetTextMetricsW(dc, &textMetrics) else {
76	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.textMetricsUnavailable
77	    }
78	    guard textMetrics.tmHeight > 0, textMetrics.tmAscent >= 0, textMetrics.tmDescent >= 0 else {
79	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.invalidMetrics
80	    }
81	
82	    // NONCLIENTMETRICS gives selected logical font height; TEXTMETRICW gives
83	    // actual selected-font cell metrics. Convert native pixels through window DPI.
84	    let fontSizeDIP = Float(fontHeightPixels) / scale
85	    let lineHeightDIP = Float(textMetrics.tmHeight) / scale
86	    guard fontSizeDIP.isFinite, fontSizeDIP > 0,
87	          lineHeightDIP.isFinite, lineHeightDIP > 0 else {
88	        throw FactoryDefaultBodyFontError.invalidMetrics
89	    }
90	    let weight = UInt32(max(0, min(Int64(logFont.lfWeight), Int64(UInt32.max))))
91	    print("FACTORY_BODY_FONT_POLICY api=SystemParametersInfoForDpi(SPI_GETNONCLIENTMETRICS)+CreateFontIndirectW+GetTextMetricsW family=\(selectedFace) dpi=\(dpi) lfHeight=\(logFont.lfHeight) fontSizeDIP=\(fontSizeDIP) tmHeightPX=\(textMetrics.tmHeight) tmAscentPX=\(textMetrics.tmAscent) tmDescentPX=\(textMetrics.tmDescent) tmExternalLeadingPX=\(textMetrics.tmExternalLeading) lineHeightDIP=\(lineHeightDIP) weight=\(weight) scale=\(scale)")
92	    return FactoryDefaultBodyFontPolicy(
93	        family: selectedFace,
94	        fontSizeDIP: fontSizeDIP,
95	        lineHeightDIP: lineHeightDIP,
96	        weight: weight,
97	        logFontHeight: logFont.lfHeight,
98	        textMetricHeight: textMetrics.tmHeight,
99	        textMetricAscent: textMetrics.tmAscent,
100	        textMetricDescent: textMetrics.tmDescent,
101	        textMetricExternalLeading: textMetrics.tmExternalLeading,
102	        sourceAPI: "SystemParametersInfoForDpi(SPI_GETNONCLIENTMETRICS)+CreateFontIndirectW+GetTextMetricsW"
103	    )
104	}
